normalized.governing_thought: US market entry: enter in 2027 through Amazon, and earn the move into specialty retail
executive_summary: Enter the US in 2027 — US K-beauty skincare is $3.6B and has grown 17% a year since 2021, against 5% for all facial skincare. 41% of it sells on Amazon, where Onsoo's six-month pilot already sells 14,000 units a month at 4.5 stars.

Lead with Amazon (A) — On the planning team's own inputs, A's cumulative cash bottoms out at −$1.9M, recovers to $2.4M by 2030, and keeps group margin at 9.5% or above. It is the only US route that passes the board's money tests.

Reject retail-led (B) — B burns $20.8M by 2030 and never pays back. It also cuts group margin to 4.5% in 2027. Its two key inputs do not hold: it assumes 4.5 units per door per week where brands at Onsoo's awareness sell 2.6, and its 1.3× Amazon "halo" rests on a correlation.
Hold Japan (J) — J is safe but small: $7M of extra revenue and $1.8M of cash by 2030, in a market growing 1.5% a year. Management can run only one launch in 2027, and the US is the larger prize.

Accept two trade-offs — No route within the cash limits reaches $40M by 2030: A reaches $26M, which points to about 2032 for $40M. And payback by 2030 holds only if Amazon ad cost stays at or below ~28.5% of sales. The plan assumes 25%, the pilot ran at 28%, and scaling brands run at 32%.

Decide in March — Approve A with a $4M cash envelope (well inside the $18M cap) and an ad-cost guardrail. Set the retail trigger at 20% aided awareness, not 15%, and restate the US ambition as $40M by 2032.

slides.title: Method, and the judgement calls made in preparing this document

claims.claim: $40M ambition: Read as a 2030 US revenue target. If the board meant "a trajectory toward $40M", A's $26M growing 29% a year may already satisfy it.
Revenue basis: Retail revenue counted at wholesale ($14), the price Onsoo receives; Amazon at $24. Shelf-price revenue would overstate B.
Cash definition: Pre-tax, undiscounted; operating result less inventory build (four months of landed cost). No receivables or payables, which would make B worse (retailer terms).
Doors and fixtures: Doors sell for the full year they are listed; fixtures paid in the year a door opens. Delisting after 12 months is not modelled, which flatters B.
Tariff stress: 25% duty applied to all four years, although the decision is due mid-2027; conservative for both options.
Group margin: Ex-US plan (11.0% margin) plus the option's revenue and operating result. Japan option used exactly as given in Table 7.
Gates and envelope: The $4M envelope, ACoS guardrails and 20% awareness gate are our proposals, derived from the pack's benchmarks.
Planning volumes: A and B volumes used as given. The pilot supports 2027 (1.8× the June run-rate with seven SKUs instead of three); later years are untested.
All inputs from the briefing pack; no outside data used. Where the pack was silent or ambiguous, the choices listed here were made; all are open to challenge.

normalized.recommendation: Enter the US in 2027 through Amazon (Option A); turn down the 600-door retail launch and hold the Japan scale-up. Decisions requested: (1) Approve US entry in 2027 through the Amazon-led route (Option A); (2) Approve a $4M envelope for cumulative US cash outflow, with board review before going beyond it; (3) Decline the 600-door national retail launch for 2027; adopt the retail gates (20% awareness, ACoS ≤ 28%, repeat ≥ 31%, self-funding retail case); (4) Restate the US ambition as "$25M+ in 2030, $40M by 2032"; (5) Hold the Japan scale-up in 2027 and revisit it for 2028.

alternatives_considered.treatment: Chosen. Only route that passes the investment, payback and margin tests: peak −$1.9M, +$2.4M by 2030, lowest group margin 9.5%. Misses the $40M ambition ($26.4M in 2030); payback at risk, needs ACoS ≤ ~28.5%.

Rejected. Burns $20.8M by 2030 and never pays back; cuts group margin to 4.5% in 2027; fails three board tests even on its own optimistic inputs. Its 4.5 units/door/week assumption vs 2.6 at Onsoo's awareness, and its 1.3× halo rests on a correlation.

Held for 2027, revisit for 2028. Safe but small: $7M of revenue and $1.8M of cash by 2030, in a market growing 1.5% a year; builds no US business. 'The Head of Japan is right that J is safer'; trades ~$19M of 2030 revenue to avoid ~$4M cash downside. Bandwidth allows one launch in 2027.

alternatives_considered.option: CEO's retail hypothesis: retail from 2029 with >15% awareness trigger and >$10M Amazon sales
alternatives_considered.treatment: Sequence agreed (Amazon first, retail later), but modified: raise awareness gate to >20%, require ACoS ≤ 28%, 90-day repeat ≥ 31%, a self-funding retail case, and decide at end-2028 on the gates rather than a fixed 2029 date.
Would need 1.67M units, 50% above plan, and buying that volume would push ACoS up; deck suggests restating the ambition instead.
